title: Undelivered Letter

sources.title: Grymforge
markers: gives a hint on a way to unlock the Harper Stash

summary: Reading can reveal the trapped Harper Stash and a way to disarm it.

fields.Read: DC 15 Investigation. Success reveals the stash location and suggests Light.
fields.Chest: Cast Light or attempt DC 20 Sleight of Hand. A failed disarm triggers Shatter, with a DC 10 Constitution save for half damage.
fields.Acquisition: Sharran Inquisitor skeleton in the Abandoned Refuge, X 584, Y 394.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
